extracted_text:
Instrument Pocket
Dimensioned test drawing. All dimensions in millimetres.
Pre-sized box stock: 72 X x 56 Y x 24 Z.
Coordinate origin: stock centre in X/Y; stock bottom Z=0; top Z=24.
One blind obround pocket: end centres A=(-12,0), B=(12,0).
Pocket radius 12; absolute floor Z=10; flat bottom.
No other features, holes, chamfers, fillets or islands.
General geometric tolerance: 3 mm. Coarse simulation demonstration.
Material: aluminium 6061. Not a production drawing.
Top view (schematic); dimensions above define the target.

result.timing_assumptions: Constant commanded vector feed/rapid speed; no acceleration, jerk, lookahead, spindle ramp or controller blending. Cut includes air cutting and plunge/retract. Tool changes add fixed duration, with no implicit travel. Full submitted plan timed even if invalid. Indexed B/C rotation uses simultaneous constant angular speeds plus settle time. No cutting during indexing.
result.scope: Indexed 3+2 only; table-attached stock and fixtures. Tool-section collision and configured axis limits; whole-machine self-collision is not certified. Gauge length is fixed across tools.
